description: Literal output hashes from the independently reviewed main, AMD and Intel builds; Intel double runs only. No tolerance comparison. The double CF hull runs' maps.f64 under every reference follow the anchored hull default (#732), which changes 16 y0 values of each, all to MATLAB's. The six double reverse-correlation hull entries (rc_hull_lh_double and rc_custom_hrf_lh_double under current, matlab-amd, and matlab-intel) follow production's adoption of MATLAB's symmetric pixel grid, stored Delaunay boundary centroid and convexHull area (#732), making both runs bit-exact against MATLAB on AMD (current/matlab-amd) and Intel (matlab-intel).
